remarks: Welcome to sought after Sheffield Ridge Condominiums. Move right into this spacious 2 bedroom corner unit with recent updates in safe elevator building. Light filled Living room/Dining area combination. Updated kitchen with granite counters, brand new carpeting, new pergo floors, new refrigerator, freshly painted. Wonderful lobby, coin operated laundry in basement. Common charges include heat and Hot Water, gated parking (unassigned),on-site super. Complex located across from Norwalk hospital. Great for investors, first time home buyers or downsizes. Close to major highways, SONO, many restaurants. A must see unit.
